To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
chemical transfection of Cy3 dye‐conjugates of miRNA precusors is a better method for transfecting primary monocytes for miRNA functional analysis compared to electroporation of siRNA constructs.
chemical transfection of Cy 3 dye conjugated miRNA precusors are suitable for miRNA functional analysis in M2 macrophage.
chemical transfection of microRNA precursors is an efficient approach for the functional analyses of microRNAs in primary human monocytes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of miRNAs that are differentially expressed between TAMs and normal macrophages, and the functional characterization of these miRNAs in M2 macrophage biology.
the development of a novel approach for the functional characterization of miRNA molecules in M2 macrophage.
the identification of novel microRNAs (miRNA) that are involved in the differentiation of M2 macroophages.

chemical transfection of Cy3‐conjugated siRNA precursors is the most suitable approach for the functional analyses of M2 macrophaes.
the chemical transfection method of dye‐conju‐gated miRNA precursers is the most suitable for the functional analysis M2 macrophage.

chemical transfection of fluorescently conjugated miRNA precursor molecules is the most suitable method of transfecting primary human monocytes with miRNA constructs for subsequent functional analysis of M‐2 macrophage differentiation.

we have established a method for the transfection of miRNAs into primary monocytes.

the chemical transfection method of dye‐congugated miRNA precursor molecules is an effective method to deliver miRNA molecules into human monocytes for subsequent miRNA functional analysis in M2 macrophage.

the chemical transfection method of dye‐congugated miRNA precursor molecules is the best‐suitted method to introduce miRNA constructs into primary human monocyte cells for subsequent miRNA functional analysis.
